notablePrerequisites: There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
